texts: good. the whole sentence is carried: the "when nightmoths are scarce" condition sits in the rule's premise (so it is never asserted on its own), sky-cats and nightmoths each get their genus link, and "sometimes" comes through as a 0.5-strength rule with the word itself recorded alongside.
